topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: I just found out that my apartment building is converting to condos. It’s a big change, and I’m trying to sort out what it means for me. There’s a lot to consider, like the financial implications and whether I’d even want to buy my unit. I’ve heard stories from friends about how these transitions can sometimes be tricky, with new rules and fees popping up. I guess my first step is to read all the documents they’ve provided and maybe talk to a lawyer or a financial advisor. I want to make sure I understand all my options before I make any decisions. It’s a lot to take in, but I’m determined to navigate this carefully.
